game.name: OvO
game.rules:
All runs require video proof. Detailed rules of each category in their rules section

Global rules:

- You are not allowed to pause the game at any time during the run.
- All runs require video proof.
- Glitches that can only be performed by manipulating lag (such as clipping through the floor at the start of level 35) are banned. Runs that have a lot of lag are subject to rejection by verifiers.
- Rebinding inputs, or using external software to set multiple keys to one input, is banned.
- Video evidence must have the full screen of OvO in view. You are not required to show bookmarks, or other tabs and windows.
- If possible, please use 60 Hz refresh rate for your monitor. This makes the game run the way it was meant to and keeps things fair. Your run may be removed if Hz is abused to give you an advantage.
- Levels that have no differences from easy and hard mode for runs submitted as hard mode will either be rejected or moved to easy mode. (1-8 and 41-52)

newsList.title: A Whole New Dimension
newsList.body:
Around the end of last year, a new OvO game called OvO Dimensions was released, and was soon added to poki. A lot of people played, and who wouldn't? There were 80 brand new levels, with two new skins unlocked per section. And of course, as Dedra always has it, there are secrets.

But that's besid
